title: AI and sequencing consensus design improves Fyn SH2 binders from affinity maturation
summary: ANCHOR used enrichment-trained classifier and regression models to build a candidate pool and derive group-specific consensus sequences for the Fyn SH2 domain. The models reached an AUROC of 0.974 and a Pearson r of 0.870 on independent test sets, and 9 of 16 evaluable consensus variants matched or exceeded the affinity of the superbinder TrM. Only one model protein was studied.
ai_technology: Enrichment-trained classifier and regression models with consensus selection (ANCHOR)
organization: University of Health and Rehabilitation Sciences; Qingdao University
